text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming inference p99 latency spike detected for model 'stable-llm-v4' in us-west-2. Threshold breached: p99>1500ms. Start: 2026-03-15T16:04:38Z

eng-oncall: Acked. I'm oncall. Paging simon and amanda. Can whoever owns GPU fleet triage? @simon @amanda

simon: Looking. Seeing elevated p95/p99 across streaming routes, but single host seems to have higher tail. Pulling logs.

amanda: Posting quick metrics: p95=420ms, p99=1.8s, streaming stall count up 320 in last 5m. Affected customers: 7 active sessions across 3 orgs. No error codes yet, just stalls.

ryan: Got node list that correlates with top tail: gpu-node-9f4c in pool-inference-west. dmesg shows repeated correctable ECC errors and GPU throttling. Past 10m:
```
[GPU 0] Volatile ECC error detected: correctable
[GPU 0] Thermal event: GPU throttled to 60% clock
[Driver] ECC corrected errors count: 124
```

jordan: If ECC + thermal both present, kernel may be re-scheduling workloads. We should drain node and failover streaming sessions to spare capacity. I'm initiating drain now.

eng-oncall: Go ahead with drain. Add rollback plan: if we see more than 10% request failures during drain, abort and route to dedicated fallback model variant.

simon: Drain command:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-9f4c
kubectl drain gpu-node-9f4c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Started at 16:07:12Z

ops-bot: Drain job started for gpu-node-9f4c by simon. Pod evacuation: 14 pods to move. ETA ~2m.

amanda: Evacuation progressing. Streaming sessions are reconnecting to other nodes, p99 dropping to ~650ms. Still seeing a handful of stalls on rebind.

ryan: Hardware note: node temps peaked at 92C prior to throttling. Suspect cooling fan speed curve failure. Raising hardware ticket with infra: HT-4652. Recommend we quarantine node and rotate GPU for postmortem.

eng-oncall: Logged incident as INC-20260315-047. Notifying support: inform affected customers and open status page update. @product-oncall can we draft customer message: short blurb, impact, mitigation in progress, ETA for resolution ~1-2h.

lee: I'll draft status. Short: 'We detected latency spikes for streaming inference in us-west-2 due to a GPU hardware issue on a single host; traffic is being rerouted and performance is improving. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for node replacement.'

jordan: After drain we saw one noisy pod that keeps reconnecting and causing backpressure; scaling edge workers by +2 fixed most of the remaining p95 spikes. Recommend adding a transient autoscale.

eng-oncall: Implementing transient scale now: scaling route 'streaming-v1' replicas +2.

ops-bot: Autoscale executed: streaming-v1 replicas increased from 6 to 8.

amanda: p99 now stabilizing at ~480ms, stalls down to baseline. Monitoring for 30m.

ryan: Hardware followup: swap scheduled in next maintenance window, but will prioritize hot-swap since it's causing customer impact.

eng-oncall: Closing on-call action items: node cordoned, hardware ticket created HT-4652, incident INC-20260315-047 created, customers notified, fallback policy executed as needed. Moving to monitoring. If p99 creeps up again, re-open and escalate to oncall-sre.

simon: Note for RCA: correlate ECC counts with firmware versions; also check recent power cycling events on rack P3-17.

amanda: Adding eval job to check model outputs for degradation to ensure quality hasn't dropped during reroute. Will report in INC ticket.

eng-oncall: Thanks all. Marking thread as resolved for now — will update incident timeline in ticket. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260315-047 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
